---
title: "Enrichment Map"
subtitle: "Where the potentially pristine samples sit, per element and fraction"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
```

Every sampling site is drawn in **grey**. On top, the sites that come out **potentially
pristine** (at or below background) are overlaid in colour, for the selected element and
fraction, on the two rules from the [Pristine Classification](./background-pristine.qmd)
page:

- **Pristine (EF < 1)**: the enrichment factor is under 1, so the site sits at or below the
  local (offshore) background once grain size is controlled by aluminium.
- **Pristine (strict)**: EF < 1 **plus** two raw-concentration screens, below the mixture
  threshold and below the offshore P90 (a subset, drawn inside the EF ring). The two extra
  screens are not grain-size controlled, so a muddy but clean site can drop out of this ring
  on grain size alone.
- **Unclassifiable**: no EF can be formed (off by default). These cluster near the coast and
  the cages, which is the key limitation: the sites under most pressure often cannot be
  classified. The cause is a reporting gap rather than a sampling one, since the Norwegian
  coastal programme that samples around the farms does not report aluminium at any distance
  (see [Pristine Classification](./background-pristine.qmd)).

Only **cobalt, copper and zinc in bulk** carry an enrichment verdict, because an enrichment
factor is an aluminium quantity and bulk is the fraction aluminium controls. Select any other
element or fraction and every site draws grey. For manganese in bulk that is a withholding:
aluminium does not predict it and dividing by it would not be a grain-size control
([Regression Normalisation](./background-regression.qmd)). For the **sieved fractions** it is
not: they are grain-size controlled by the sieve, so no enrichment factor is defined for them
and they are judged without one on the
[Pristine Classification](./background-pristine.qmd) page. Selenium and molybdenum are
withheld for a third reason, most of their values having fallen below the limit of
quantification. Concentrations for every group are on the
[Background Map](./background-map.qmd).

None of the rules use aquaculture information. Values are averaged per site **before** the
thresholds are applied, so the map is a different classifier from the per-measurement one,
not just a coarser drawing of it: a site whose measurements straddle a threshold can land
either side of it once averaged. The per-measurement counts on the analysis pages are the
authoritative ones.

{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
L = require("https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js")

home_lat = 65
home_lng = 10
home_zoom = 3

elements = [
  { label: "Cobalt (Co)",     value: "CO" },
  { label: "Copper (Cu)",     value: "CU" },
  { label: "Iodine (I)",      value: "I" },
  { label: "Manganese (Mn)",  value: "MN" },
  { label: "Molybdenum (Mo)", value: "MO" },
  { label: "Selenium (Se)",   value: "SE" },
  { label: "Zinc (Zn)",       value: "ZN" }
]

fractions = [
  { label: "Bulk",          value: "bulk",     clause: "AND m.frac_class = 'bulk'" },
  { label: "Sieved <63 um", value: "sieved63", clause: "AND m.frac_class = 'sieved' AND m.sieve_um_std = 63" },
  { label: "Sieved <20 um", value: "sieved20", clause: "AND m.frac_class = 'sieved' AND m.sieve_um_std = 20" }
]

pristine_types = [
  { key: "pristine_ef",     label: "Pristine (EF < 1)",   color: "#228833", radius: 8 },
  { key: "pristine_strict", label: "Pristine (strict)",   color: "#004488", radius: 5 },
  { key: "unclassifiable",  label: "Unclassifiable", color: "#CCBB44", radius: 6 }
]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Per element x fraction thresholds, loaded from the analysis CSVs.
ef_bg      = FileAttachment("data/refined_summary/refined_ef_background.csv").csv({ typed: true })
bg_compare = FileAttachment("data/refined_summary/refined_background_compare.csv").csv({ typed: true })
mix_comp   = FileAttachment("data/refined_summary/refined_mixture_components.csv").csv({ typed: true })

thresholds = {
  const m = new Map()
  const put = (k, f) => { const o = m.get(k) ?? {}; f(o); m.set(k, o) }
  // A group with no enrichment factor gets no threshold here either, and every site in it
  // draws as unclassifiable. Three ways to get there: aluminium does not predict the metal
  // (manganese in bulk), most values fell below the LOQ (Se, Mo), or the fraction is
  // sieved, where the sieve is the grain-size control and no EF is defined. Only the first
  // two are withholdings; the sieved fractions are judged on the Pristine page instead.
  for (const r of ef_bg)
    put(r.symbol + "|" + r.cat, o => {
      o.no_verdict = (r.withheld === true || r.withheld === "TRUE" ||
                      r.unnormalisable === true || r.unnormalisable === "TRUE")
      o.efbg = o.no_verdict ? null : r.bg_ratio_al
    })
  for (const r of bg_compare) put(r.symbol + "|" + r.cat, o => o.p90 = r.p90_off10)
  for (const r of mix_comp)   put(r.symbol + "|" + r.cat, o => o.mix = r.threshold)
  return m
}
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar

viewof selected_element = Inputs.select(elements, {
  label: "Element:", format: d => d.label
})

viewof selected_fraction = Inputs.select(fractions, {
  label: "Fraction:", format: d => d.label, value: fractions[0]
})

viewof shown_types = Inputs.checkbox(pristine_types, {
  label: "Show:", format: d => d.label, value: pristine_types.slice(0, 2)
})
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill

map_data = db.query(`
  SELECT si.latitude  AS latitude,
         si.longitude AS longitude,
         AVG(m.value_std) AS avg_value,
         AVG(m.ratio_al)  AS avg_ratio_al
  FROM measurement m
    JOIN subsample sub ON sub.subsample_id = m.subsample_id
    JOIN event e       ON e.event_id       = sub.event_id
    JOIN site si       ON si.site_id       = e.site_id
  WHERE m.symbol = '${selected_element.value}'
    ${selected_fraction.clause}
    AND m.outlier_flag IS NULL
    AND si.latitude IS NOT NULL AND si.longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY si.latitude, si.longitude
`)

th = thresholds.get(selected_element.value + "|" + selected_fraction.value) ?? {}

pristine_ef_ok = d =>
  th.efbg != null && d.avg_ratio_al != null && d.avg_ratio_al < th.efbg

classify_pr = (d, key) =>
    key === "pristine_ef"     ? pristine_ef_ok(d)
  : key === "pristine_strict" ? (pristine_ef_ok(d)
        && d.avg_value != null
        && th.mix != null && d.avg_value < th.mix
        && th.p90 != null && d.avg_value < th.p90)
  : key === "unclassifiable"  ? (th.efbg == null || d.avg_ratio_al == null)
  : false

fmtVal = v => v == null ? "N/A" : (v >= 1000 ? v.toFixed(0) : v.toFixed(2)) + " mg/kg"

{
  const container = html`<div class="map-container"><div id="map"></div></div>`
  yield container

  if (!container._map) {
    const map = L.map(container.querySelector("#map"), { zoomControl: true })
      .setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
    }).addTo(map)

    const HomeControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "topleft" },
      onAdd(map) {
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create("a", "leaflet-home-button")
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-expand" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
        btn.title = "Reset view"
        L.DomEvent.on(btn, "click", e => {
          L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e)
          map.setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
        })
        return btn
      }
    })
    new HomeControl().addTo(map)

    const LegendControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "bottomright" },
      onAdd() { const d = L.DomUtil.create("div", "legend"); d.id = "map-legend"; return d }
    })
    new LegendControl().addTo(map)

    container._map = map
    container._markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map)
  }

  const { _map: map, _markers: markers } = container

  const legendEl = map.getContainer().querySelector("#map-legend")
  if (legendEl) {
    legendEl.innerHTML =
      `<div class="legend-title">${selected_element.label}</div>` +
      `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#555;margin-bottom:4px">${selected_fraction.label}</div>` +
      `<div class="legend-row"><span class="legend-swatch" style="background:#bbb"></span>All sites</div>` +
      shown_types.map(t =>
        `<div class="legend-row"><span class="legend-swatch" style="background:${t.color}"></span>${t.label}</div>`
      ).join("")
  }

  markers.clearLayers()

  // grey base: every site with data
  for (const d of map_data) {
    L.circleMarker([d.latitude, d.longitude], {
      radius: 3, fillColor: "#bbb", color: "#999", weight: 0.4, fillOpacity: 0.5, opacity: 0.6
    }).addTo(markers)
  }

  // pristine overlays, largest ring first so the strict subset sits on top
  for (const t of shown_types) {
    for (const d of map_data) {
      if (!classify_pr(d, t.key)) continue
      L.circleMarker([d.latitude, d.longitude], {
        radius: t.radius, fillColor: t.color, color: "#333", weight: 0.6, fillOpacity: 0.75, opacity: 1
      }).bindTooltip(
        `<b>${t.label}</b><br>${selected_element.label}: ${fmtVal(d.avg_value)}`,
        { sticky: true }
      ).addTo(markers)
    }
  }
}

counts = ({
  all: map_data.length,
  ef: map_data.filter(d => classify_pr(d, "pristine_ef")).length,
  strict: map_data.filter(d => classify_pr(d, "pristine_strict")).length,
  unclass: map_data.filter(d => classify_pr(d, "unclassifiable")).length
})

map_data.length === 0
  ? md`*No data for this selection.*`
  : th.efbg == null
  ? md`**${selected_element.label}** · ${selected_fraction.label} · **${counts.all}** sites · *no enrichment verdict for this group: it is a sieved fraction, where the sieve is the grain-size control and no enrichment factor is defined (those are judged on the [Pristine Classification](./background-pristine.qmd) page), or aluminium does not predict this element in bulk, or most of its values fell below the limit of quantification. Concentrations are on the [Background Map](./background-map.qmd).*`
  : md`**${selected_element.label}** · ${selected_fraction.label} · **${counts.all}** sites · pristine EF **${counts.ef}** · strict **${counts.strict}** · unclassifiable **${counts.unclass}**`
```
